blocks.text: The Boise Boys are back, and we’ve got something big in the works! Luke and Clint are teaming up again for a brand new show. You’ll soon be able to catch them on a free streaming channel, and you’ll get an up-close look at our design decisions and home tutorials like never before.
“People keep asking ‘where’s the Boise Boys? When are you going to be back?’ It’s been going on but we’ve just had to be patient while we’ve had things in the works.”
Filming is set to begin this year.
We’re gearing up for our most educational season yet, and we can’t wait to share it. Whether you’re a DIY fan or just love a good home transformation, this one's for you.

Idaho Press ran an article with a sneak peek of what’s coming, including how the new show will differ from “Boise Boys” and “Outgrown“. Think shorter episodes focused on design decisions and home tutorials.
Want the full story? Head over to Idaho Press’s website and read the whole article. Stay tuned for details.

The article dives deep into Luke’s journey, from his days as a touring musician to building a realty firm, his current success as the founder of Timber + Love Realty, now recognized as a top 1% real estate firm in Boise. You’ll also get the inside scoop on how Timber + Love Design|Build came to be, and the heartwarming story behind Luke’s family, including their inspiring adoption journey.
